name: omi_pipeline_upload_admission_503
description: Backend-sync upload-admission 266-byte 503 size class; custody-wait proxy, not response body attribution. Alert-only.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend-sync" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.requestMethod="POST" AND httpRequest.requestUrl=~"^https?://[^/]+/v2/sync-local-files/?([?].*)?$" AND httpRequest.status=503 AND httpRequest.responseSize=266

name: omi_pipeline_firestore_contention_exhausted
description: FirestoreContentionExhausted log entries on batch sync/integration services. No IDs or free-text labels. Alert-only.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name=("backend-sync" OR "backend-sync-backfill" OR "backend-integration") AND (textPayload:"FirestoreContentionExhausted" OR jsonPayload.message:"FirestoreContentionExhausted")

name: omi_pipeline_owner_drain_advanced
description: Advanced rows per completed serving or dedicated-pump owner_drain turn, including zero-progress turns. _sum gives rows, _count gives turns. Alert-only.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name=("backend-sync" OR "backend-sync-backfill" OR "backend-integration" OR "backend-projection-pump") AND textPayload:"event=batch_projection action=owner_drain outcome=turn "

name: omi_pipeline_owner_drain_claim_busy
description: Completed serving or dedicated-pump owner_drain turns ending stop=claim_busy; denominator is advanced distribution _count. Alert-only.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name=("backend-sync" OR "backend-sync-backfill" OR "backend-integration" OR "backend-projection-pump") AND textPayload:"event=batch_projection action=owner_drain outcome=turn " AND textPayload=~" stop=claim_busy([[:space:]]|$)"
